title: Fixed-length block extraction
statement: Let $l$ be a finite list, let $g$ assign to each element of $l$ a list of length $c$, and let $rest$ be any list. For every index $i$ with $i<|l|$, the block of length $c$ beginning at position $ic$ in the concatenation of the flattened lists $g(a)$, for $a$ in $l$, followed by $rest$, is exactly $g(l_i)$.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a list of elements of type $\alpha$
$g$ maps each element to a list of elements of type $\beta$
$rest$ is a list of elements of type $\beta$
